Contents

Read the seven chapters in order for a first playthrough. The quest journal and atlas are linked both ways, so you can also start with the quest or place on your screen.

Route at a glance

1. The fallen star Redpaw Village • Bear Woods • Mount Tamborine

2. The ranger summit Oakhaven • Rosegarde • Serpent’s Peak

3. The spellbloom Grimsby • Misty Mines • Cedarwood Grove

4. The missing professor Bear Woods revisited • Mud Fever Marsh • Techbase Omega

5. The broken bridge Techbase Gamma • Hilgarth Forest • Hilgarth Heights

6. Climate control Techbase Alpha • Folly Forest • Brooksilver • Norkeep

7. The five Aegis Stones Redpaw • Darkwing Shore • The Marylands • Dead Man’s Bay • Lovey Dovey

Sources and verification

Route at a glance

Pick up meteors as you travel, and give relationship rewards to the intended character when prompted. Both decisions pay off much later. The individual meteor sites, nine gifts and final summit trigger are in the collections section.

StageWhat opens the next region
Chapter 1Find Aura, finish her initiation and rescue the missing pirate captain. Sail from Bear’s Beach.
Chapter 2Expose Crableg, complete the three rangers’ jobs and fight Pythera. Request the king’s trade pass.
Chapter 3Resolve the mine dispute, clear the dynamite obstruction and carry the spellbloom to Thyme.
Chapter 4Trace the missing ship, rescue Kirk and climb Mudpile Ridge. Board the underground train.
Chapter 5Collect five Iron Webs, repair the bridge and reach Hilgarth Heights.
Chapter 6Help Quack and Megabrain, finish the climate tests, then take the Fire Rocks to Aura in Norkeep.
Chapter 7Complete five stone routes. Collect both guild keys, finish wedding preparations and fly to Inselberg.

Finding a spot: the three-digit number identifies a map in this guide. Coordinates are counted in tiles from its upper-left corner; x increases to the right, y downward. A house interior can contain several separate rooms on one coordinate grid. Use its entrance and the arrival coordinates in the atlas to find the right door. A scene’s listed position can belong to an invisible event; follow the chapter instructions when a scene starts automatically.

1. The fallen star

Redpaw Village • Bear Woods • Mount Tamborine

  1. The crash in Bear Woods

    After the opening and Zach’s introduction, take the tutorial if you want the weapon merchant’s errand. On Redpaw Outskirts · tutorial 110, talk to the merchant, recover his Rabbit Pie from the fox and return it before leaving north. On Bear Woods · Crash 032, start at the southern end and work north to (21,10) to find the fallen star. Continue the escape and barn scenes until you can explore Redpaw as Aura.

  2. The dress and the hidden clubhouse

    In Redpaw Village 131, meet Penelope by (7,24). In her house Redpaw Village interiors 108, use the dresser at (6,7); choosing “Take this” confirms the dress. Speak to Penelope at (18,14). After the scene outside, use the eastern village exit around (84,10). In Bear Woods East Bear Woods · East 031, enter the hideout at (6–7,42). Inside Girl's Club HQ 107, approach the girls at the far side of the room.

  3. Earn the Butterflies’ vote

    Talk to the twins and Pauline first. Pick five red flowers around Redpaw, and buy cider from the village item vendor at (140,8) on Redpaw Village interiors 028. Bring both back. Madeline then sends you to the boys’ base. From Redpaw Hill Redpaw Hill 056, use the entrance at (4–5,55); examine the coveted treasure at (20,19) on Lads Club HQ 058, survive the interruption and give it to Madeline. Attend the initiation in the park.

  4. Timothy’s trap

    Speak with Vern at (50,48) in Redpaw Village 131 about the cage. Meet the girls by the scrapyard and ask Timothy’s mother at (176,6) on Redpaw Village interiors 028. Tell Madeline about the peanut cookies. Put her letter on the sign at (5,61) in Redpaw Hill 056, then approach the waiting girls near (10,45). Let the clubhouse sequence play through.

  5. Tavern, summit, ship

    Head to Crow’s Beak Tavern via the east woods. From Bear Woods · Tavern 053 take the north exit to Mt Tamborine 054 and reach (24,41). After the sighting, go to Bear’s Beach Bear's Beach 132, talk to Shabadoo and search Bear Caves Bear Caves · Caves 109 at (37,16). Return to the beach and sail. Before leaving, Tanner is outside the tavern; Charlie and Merl are inside Crow's Beak Tavern 059.

2. The ranger summit

Oakhaven • Rosegarde • Serpent’s Peak

  1. The blocked path

    From Evergreen Shore Evergreen Shore 092, go to Oakhaven Oakhaven 051. Talk to the guard at (59,31), then Hawkeye inside Oakhaven interiors 090 at (102,9). Return to the north of town and meet Hobbin at (32,3). Find Scarbeck at (6,10) in Rosegarde Inn Rosegarde Inn 091. Approach Crableg in western Rosegarde Rosegarde · Left 087 at (64,4); follow the lead to his forest office Crableg's Office 086, then take the evidence back to Hawkeye. Sleep at the Oakhaven inn.

  2. Prepare the rangers

    Take all three assignments. In Evergreen Forest · main area 042, bring Mirka one egg of each color at (62,25) and Wallace five Glass Orbs at (99,67). For Hennibus, visit Evergreen Forest · North 041 at (41,5), defeat the king in Badger King Cave Cave of the Badger King 137, then report to Hennibus. Return to Hobbin’s gathering near (85,38) on Evergreen Forest · main area 042.

  3. Serpent’s Peak and the trade pass

    Make the assault, reach (23,53) on Serpent's Peak 046, fight Pythera near (51,40), then continue to the summit at (52,29). Back in Rosegarde, visit Thyme in the healer’s rooms Rosegarde interiors 119 around (101,9). Request a trade pass from King Thorn at (15,7) on King's Landing · royal court 120. Cross Amber Way Amber Way 094 to Grimsby Grimsby 095.

  4. Detour for Scarbeck

    The detective case starts near (69,60) in west Rosegarde Rosegarde · Left 087. Several clues point back here from Grimsby; keep the case open while following the main story. The journal section gives each interview and the final confrontation separately.

3. The spellbloom

Grimsby • Misty Mines • Cedarwood Grove

  1. Gain access to the mines

    Speak to Marcia at (21,15) in Grimsby 095, then Rex at (20,17) in Mistvale Forest 100. Get the Mining Pass from Old Man Barnabus at (121,12) on Grimsby interiors 099. Speak with Barnabus Jr. at (59,51) in the forest, then the miners. Sheb at (101,10) in Misty Mines 101 advances the investigation; bring coffee.

  2. Expose Barnabus Jr.

    Take the Gem Polisher. The four gemstone sites are Mistvale Forest 100 (53,38) and (21,44), and Misty Mines 101 (30,12) and (32,100). After the fourth, attend the meeting in Amber Way 094 at (9,10). Return to Barnabus Jr. with the evidence. At the obstruction in Mistbegotten Cave · blocked passage 136 (14,37), go back to Grimsby and speak to Dynamo at (240,7) on Grimsby interiors 099. Meet him in the cave at (6,33).

  3. Recover the spellbloom

    Continue through Mistbegotten Cave to Cedarwood Grove 052. The spellbloom scene is at (46,29). On the chess detour, defeat the piece encounters in the grove and in the outdoor pocket Cedarwood Grove · Out 187 beyond Cedarwood Grove · Cave 186; return to the board on Cedarwood Grove · Chess 062 for the gods’ match. Take the spellbloom back to Thyme at (107,14) on Rosegarde interiors 119.

  4. Finish the ghosts’ business

    In Grimsby 095, Rose at (61,39) needs three mementos, then stationery. Deliver the letter to Chester on your next visit to Redpaw. The other ghost at (17,38) wants an heirloom from Grim Crossing. For Emily, speak to the barista, collect coffee beans, descend the well, replace the stock at (277,11) on Grimsby interiors 099 and report back to Emily at (139,10).

4. The missing professor

Bear Woods revisited • Mud Fever Marsh • Techbase Omega

  1. Return to the crash

    Backtrack to the crash site at (21,10) on Bear Woods · Crash 032. Check the door at (5,29), follow the tracks, then examine (38,13) to advance the search. On the way, investigate the bear watch in Bear Woods · North 030 at (33,31) and rescue the girls in Bear Caves · Caves 109 around (59,55). Enter Omega Techbase Omega 037 and ask the assistant in Professor Kirk’s lab Techbase Omega interiors 164 at (103,10).

  2. Reach the stranded scientist

    Approach the rescue site in Mud Fever Marsh · Rescue 036 at (23,21). Investigate the cavern entrance at (72,12) in Mud Fever Marsh · main area 034. Visit the mad scientist at (27,8) in Mad Scientist's House 170, take the Illogical Chip and enter Illogical Caverns 169. For the frog at (41,49) select Da, Di, Da, Di, La. In the cat room collect the hat at (13,11); give it to the trendsetter while the other three cats meet the hat condition. In Rocky’s room speak to Rocky, then use the south approach at (74,26). In the bird room switch (63,74) to white and leave at (70,83). Collect the Illogical Item at (16,71). The scientist exchanges it for a Logic Displacer. Use the teleporter and speak directly to Kirk at (14,14) on Mud Fever Marsh · Rescue 036.

  3. Climb while Kirk works

    Visit Kirk in Techbase Omega interiors 164 at (102,10). Climb Mudpile Ridge Mudpile Ridge 044 and reach (24,19). Return to his lab, then go to Techbase Omega · Train 172, (13,12), to board the underground train. The extra marsh projects can span several visits. In particular the nitrous merchant is in Omega Techbase Omega interiors 164 at (35,11), despite the journal naming Alpha.

5. The broken bridge

Techbase Gamma • Hilgarth Forest • Hilgarth Heights

  1. Cross the spider country

    The journey leads through Techbase Gamma Techbase Gamma 154. From the story trigger at (20,38), travel through Hilgarth Forest Hilgarth Forest 038 into Hilgarth Heights 153. Examine the damaged bridge at (41,70) before gathering supplies. Search the defeated ironweb spiders for five Iron Webs: four in Gamma’s interiors Techbase Gamma interiors 201 and one in the forest Hilgarth Forest 038, then examine the same bridge to make the crossing.

  2. Take the summit path

    Continue through the heights, using the cave links on Hilgarth Heights 153 and Hilgarth Cave 203 to change elevation. Reach (16,19) on Hilgarth Heights 153 to start the summit scene. Let the Dawnspire interlude run, then follow the transfer into the Alpha storyline. The summit scene advances the plot even though its journal entry has no separate clearing command.

6. Climate control

Techbase Alpha • Folly Forest • Brooksilver • Norkeep

  1. Professor Quack and the creature

    Find Quack in Techbase Alpha interiors 194 at (21,10). Scout southeastern Folly Forest Folly Forest · southeast 168 around (12,21), return to Quack, and obtain the Shiny Ball Kit. The capture encounter is in the northeastern quadrant Folly Forest · northeast 166 near (15,34). Return to Quack; gather five Forest Berries and deliver them. Speak with Lord Megabrain at (153,8) on Techbase Alpha interiors 194, sample the water behind the tree at (10,8) on Folly Forest · Extra 217, and return it to him.

  2. Repair the manual and retrieve the beacon

    Meet Testronomo at (47,80) on Brooksilver 080. Recover the manual near (24,14). Read the four scraps before answering: Brooksilver 080 (21,25), Beta Cave 219 (51,31), Brooksilver 080 (51,46), Beta Cave 219 (12,8). Reassemble the pages at (49,80), (51,80), (53,80), (55,80) in that order: Panic, Circuitboard, Heard, Turn on. Speak to Testronomo again. For the scientist at (50,5), recover the Weather Beacon from the crystal crabs’ cave and return it.

  3. Finish beta testing

    Talk to the scientist at (14,50) on Brooksilver 080, round up six fleeing testers, and report to the same scientist. Complete the test scene in Beta Cave 219, then continue toward the Icewind Plains via Icewind Climb Icewind Climb 180.

  4. Five rocks, then five stones

    At the entrance to Norkeep · Town 155, Zach already carries three Fire Rocks. Collect the two at (40,79) and (22,76). Visit Aura inside Norkeep interiors 193 at (186,7), then enter the Memory Chambers Memory Chambers 223 and reach (17,4). The Elder gives you a new objective. Fire Rocks and Aegis Stones belong to two different quests.

Quest-by-quest solutions for chapter 6  ·  Map index

7. The five Aegis Stones

Redpaw • Darkwing Shore • The Marylands • Dead Man’s Bay • Lovey Dovey

  1. Darkwing Shore and the first lead

    Visit Mayor Snide at (43,10) on Darkwing Shore interiors 232. Leave his house and re-enter. Speak with Master Kent at (12,66) on Darkwing Shore · Town 157; introduce Mila to the darkwings in Scarfield Woods 158. Report back and get the Blackheart Cave key from Snide. Find the cursed darkwing in Blackheart Cave 237 at (22,7), report to Kent, confront Snide, then ask Queen Rose in King's Landing · royal court 120 at (13,7) for the Special Rock. Bring it to the same darkwing to lift the curse and receive an Aegis Stone. The Queen also sets the Marylands guard errand in motion.

  2. The Marylands vault needs both keys

    Relieve both guards on The Marylands 102 at (65,8) and (16,7). Join the Scrappers in the southeast and the Trappers in the north. Work for both. For the Scrappers, collect ten armor scraps, retrieve ten steel traps, deal with the defector, plant the banner and deliver iron boots to Prince Thorn. For the Trappers, lay ten traps, bring ten skunkfox hides, plant their banner, have a fake map made, swap maps and find Shybeard. Finish the jacket delivery. Return to each leader for a Wreckers Key. Use the two keys at (10,54) on The Marylands 102 and collect the stone at (10,6) on The Marylands interiors 083.

  3. Dead Man’s Bay and the replacement treasure

    Start the hunt at (72,38) on Dead Man's Bay 162 and dig at (54,41). After the theft, read the pirates’ map at (8,8) on Pirate Cave 236, ask Shybeard at (71,42) to translate, then search (40,8) on Dead Man's Bay 162. Ask Pegleg Steve in the bar on Dead Man's Bay interiors 234 and find the captain at (55,28) outside. Obtain pirate clothes, enter the occupied base at (76,7) on Dead Man's Bay interiors 234, then go out back and dig at (17,36) on Dead Man's Bay 162 for the stone. While here, get the Beloved Item at (34,38) after speaking with Madeline about a substitute.

  4. The coveted item in Redpaw

    At the old lads’ base Lads Club HQ 058, examine (20,19), then ask Madeline at (18,22) about destroying the treasure. Bring her the Beloved Item from Dead Man’s Bay. The exchange releases another Aegis Stone.

  5. Restore love on Lovey Dovey Island

    Speak to Casey and Mayor Jennings in the town hall Lovey Dovey Town interiors 235, then to Esmeralda at (55,6). Clear the Tunnel of Love Tunnel of Love 084 for the innkeeper. Recover Casey’s ring at (61,47) in Lovey Dovey Town 160, arrange a unicorn in Unicorn Cave 163 and a chef at (36,53) in Lovey Dovey Town 160; the chef accepts Imitation Crab Meat from Amber Way 094 at (32,45). Complete Zelda and Crudis E.’s date and park errands as well. Report to Casey and Esmeralda, then take the Love Potion to Mayor Jennings in Lovey Dovey Town interiors 235 at (125,5) for the stone. Pick up Cupid’s Arrow in the unicorn cave before leaving if you want Thyme’s wedding.

  6. Before flying to Inselberg

    Take all five Aegis Stones to the Elder at (8,7) in Memory Chambers 223. Aura shares their power; her companions gain ten levels. The Elder asks separately whether you want to depart. This is a good place for a separate save. Finish wedding preparations, the collector chain, meteor hunting and any remaining journal entries before saying yes.

  7. The last three maps

    On Inselberg Inselberg 300, collect the chest and meteor before taking the northern passage. On Inselberg 306, approach (32,63) for the Chancellor and two goons, then (10,36) for the first Xyrilius fight. Continue north to Inselberg 307. Its southern entrance is around (20,124); the final confrontation triggers near (13,61). Win the final encounter to start the ending scenes. The game takes control of travel during the epilogue.

Collectors, weddings & meteors

This section reveals the conditions for the ending scenes. Keep a save in Norkeep before accepting the Elder’s flight.

The collectors’ trade

1. Fenced house, Darkwing Shore. Start with the collector → Letter Opener. Darkwing Shore interiors 232

2. Upper floor of the Norkeep inn. Letter Opener → Rare Snowflake. Norkeep interiors 193

3. Lovey Dovey inn. Rare Snowflake → Bronze Coin. Lovey Dovey Town interiors 235

4. Upper floor of the Dead Man’s Bay inn. Bronze Coin → Stylish Moccasins. Dead Man's Bay interiors 234

5. Marylands guild hall. Stylish Moccasins → Mind Controller. The Marylands interiors 078

6. Techbase Alpha transport room. Mind Controller → Pocket Watch. Techbase Alpha interiors 194

7. Original collector in Darkwing Shore. Pocket Watch → Shoal Pendant. Darkwing Shore interiors 232

Zach and Aura

Collect all nine relationship points. At a gift-or-sell choice, give the gift. Once the total reaches nine, visit Icewind Pinnacle from Norkeep, walk to (62,17) on Icewind Pinnacle 122 and watch the proposal before the final battle. The proposal sets the wedding flag.

GiftWhere to earn the point
Butterfly PendantCatch five butterflies and return to Hildhilda at (13,27) in Rosegarde · Left 087.
Fish EarringsPlant ten flowers for Bloomhilda at (3,31) in Rosegarde · Left 087. Give the earrings to Aura.
Dog BraceletFinish Wenhilda’s Grim Flower errand and report to (46,25) in Amber Way 094. Give the bracelet to Aura.
Star GuideDeliver Rose’s letter to Chester, (52,13) in Redpaw Village 131. Give the guide to Zach.
Astronomical WatchBuy from the scientist at (28,31) in Techbase Alpha 043 for 2,000 gold.
SnowflowerBuy at (16,50) in Norkeep · Town 155 for 1,500 gold.
BandanaBuy at (34,34) in Dead Man's Bay 162 for 1,100 gold.
Love Heart NecklaceBuy at (27,55) in Lovey Dovey Town 160 for 2,200 gold.
Shoal PendantFinish the collector loop and give the pendant to Aura.

Grayson and Thyme • Mila and the darkwing

Open the Cupid’s Arrow chest at (76,36) in Unicorn Cave 163. Equip Cupid’s Arrow on Thyme, put both characters in the fighting party, and have Thyme use Love Arrow on Grayson. Each use on Grayson adds one to the internal counter. The epilogue tests for at least nine uses; the relationship display divides that count by two. Eighteen uses brings the display to nine and also satisfies the Steam guide’s recommendation. Mila’s romance advances through the Darkwing Shore stone quest: break the curse in Blackheart Cave and let the reunion play.

Aura’s meteor skills

Each meteor raises Aura’s maximum mana and puts one point in the school you pick. The table shows the cumulative points within each school. A first Light point gives Aura a single-target heal; five Light points give her a revival. The atlas table below lists the pickup events that call the meteor routine, including the early scripted finds.

Quest solutions

Use the wording from your journal to find an objective. Tick the box beside a finished objective to track it. The HTML version remembers your checks in the same browser when local storage is available. Each entry gives its starting event and completion event when present. Pickup lists include chests, field items and searchable enemy remains. Some objects only appear after the quest begins.

Story objectives

Q117 Defeat Xyrilius in Inselberg

Start   Memory Chambers 223 (8,7) · Elder.

Tell the Elder you are ready and cross Inselberg 300. Fight the Chancellor and both goons at (32,63) in Inselberg 306, then Xyrilius at (10,36). In Inselberg 307, approach (13,61). The final fight brings in two yetis on turn three and three stardogs on turn six; keep group-healing and multi-target skills ready. Victory starts the epilogue.

Optional. Scarbeck’s detective case

Start in western Rosegarde. In Johnny’s house, inspect the evidence before following the blood trail. The coffee-stain investigation takes you to Grimsby. Complete both interviews and the coffee lead so that the lookout investigation opens; return to Rosegarde, then visit Grim Crossing for the last conversation.

Sources and verification

The chapter order, quest wording, tile coordinates, dungeon connections, quantity checks, item transactions, battle triggers and ending branches were read from the local Stargazer RPG Maker XP resources. The route was reconstructed from event data; this guide was not verified by playing every branch on a Switch. A mapped transfer may be conditional, and moving NPC coordinates give their event origin.

Local game data. MapInfos.rxdata and Map001–Map330.rxdata (329 map records), CommonEvents.rxdata, Items.rxdata, Skills.rxdata, Troops.rxdata, plus the Ruby quest and story-progress tables. Event-template clones were resolved to the instance’s map position. The illustrations use the game’s local tilesets. Source registration and direct map transfers are audited separately.

Steam route planning. Someone Wicked’s two community guides identify optional objectives worth preparing for during the story. The collector trades, gifts and meteor skill thresholds were cross-checked against the local event data. Stargazer guide index · Collectors Quests and Weddings · Meteors.

Format reference. The location-first chapters and separate spoiler/reference sections follow the approach of over_cloud9’s Aveyond 3.2: Gates of Night walkthrough.
